Theorem 1 (Chapter 133)

Subject: analysis | ID: 22139

Corollary

Let H be a Fock space. Every bounded operator T in B(H) with operator norm less than 1 satisfies the Neumann series expansion.

Proof

Step 1. The lattice operator \(Q_{01330011}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle Q_{01330011} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Step 2. The uniform operator \(A_{01330012}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle A_{01330012} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Step 3. Applying the self-adjoint interpolation theorem to \(S_{01330013}\), we obtain the norm bound in the mixed Lebesgue scale for the appropriate exponents.

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via algebraic interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_01330011 \cdot C_01330012 \cdot C_01330013\).
